41.
The  Extradition  Law,  No.  8  of  1977  is  hereby
amended by the insertion immediately before Part B of the
Schedule to that Law, of the following item:—
“(51) An  offence  within  the  meaning  of  the  Chemical
Weapons  Convention  Act,  No.  58  of  2007.”.

42.
Where there is an extradition arrangement made by
the Government of Sri Lanka with any State in force on the
date on which this Act comes into operation, such arrangement
shall be deemed, for the purposes of the Extradition Law, No.
8 of 1977, to include provision for extradition in respect of
the offences specified in this Act.
